text:
No option can be put forward yet: the £400k annual-salary limit was not checkable in this run, so it was excluded from the comparison.

- The result is **fragile** and rests on six Olumi-supplied values, rather than user evidence. Delivery capacity is the most sensitive assumption; its value source is Olumi’s estimate.
- The goal direction was not stated, so the comparison assumed that more platform-delivery progress is better.
- The model’s annual-salary figure is calculated as a change, not an annual total in £/year, so it cannot be tested against **≤ £400k/year**.
